title: The Last Car
synopsis: Snow, an iron bridge, and the Hush right behind. To save his passengers, Rook leaves something behind: the last car, and its lantern.
note: The last train runs again tomorrow.
lines: Snow tonight, passengers. Hold the bar.
One bridge, then the mountain lights.
It's too close. Unhook the last car!
The lantern stays. Look at the light!
Snow on the track. We're stuck.
It will climb out. It always does.
We lost a car. Not one passenger.
